title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: The same defect one layer down
summary: Yesterday's fix narrowed the search from the whole line to the modifier run. The modifier run still contained the arguments of the annotations.

highlights.title: An annotation argument is not a modifier
highlights.description: Making a member private rewrote @SerializedName("internal ") into @SerializedName("private "), which renames a JSON field and says nothing about it.

highlights.title: Parentheses balanced, strings skipped
highlights.description: The annotation scanner counts nested parentheses and steps over string bodies. An annotation it cannot close on the line yields no edit rather than a guess.

highlights.title: Two suspicions dropped, not shipped
highlights.description: Zero posts alone in a scope function on a 6300 file project, and 4363 test function extents checked on 901 real files with no violation.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The visibility keyword is read from the modifiers alone, never from an annotation's arguments.
An annotation whose parentheses cannot be closed on the line yields no edit.
